name: Golems
description: Iron golems that work for you, at half your pace, with the tool you hand them. They level ground, fell and replant trees, keep a wheat field, and fight with a sword or shoot with a bow. A Golem Core on two stacked iron blocks makes one. It works inside four Boundary Poles or 16 blocks round where it was handed its tool, carries what it gathers to a chest nearby, and takes spare tools, seeds, saplings, arrows and iron to mend itself from that chest.
